title: LinkPeer 1.3.0 Available
message: This update delivers faculty designation credentials, instant app-themed bottom sheet dropdowns, automatic read notifications, production AdMob stability, and web version links.
features: Faculty credentials (Designation & Department) on profile header
Preselected branch, stream, department & year choices in Edit Profile
App-themed instant bottom-sheet selectors replacing slow dropdown popups
Automatic mark-all-notifications-as-read when visiting Notification Screen
Web version links (linkpeer.swynx.dev) integrated across the app
Production Google AdMob policy compliance & native surface crash fixes
